details.compares: native showinfo pick from 17 sources; 113 checks: 5 sources byte-exact on every path, 12 refused by name on every path and CLI backend

unsupported: yuva422p, yuva444p and every 9-16 bit alpha format: no frame storage; refused by name at plan time. Native picks yuva422p/yuva444p for every non-4:2:0 source (yuv422p, yuv444p, yuvj422p, yuvj444p, gray, rgb24, bgr24, gbrp, rgba, bgra, argb, abgr).
enable= timeline (refused: 'Lumakey timeline expressions are not implemented')
Runtime commands threshold/tolerance/softness/enable (refused with the unsupported code)
Option expressions and constants such as 1/2 or 0x1 (refused: 'Only constant decimal lumakey <option> values are implemented')

notes: The sandbox reference is an unpinned build (--allow-unpinned-reference): sha256 ac302e4d... differs from the linux-x64 pin in compat/reference-pins.json; commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm are asserted at test time.
No float-sensitive case: each bound is (a +/- b) * 255 truncated, so is softness * 255 truncated, then integer keying. No case is platform-gated.
Native default threads and -filter_threads 1 agree on every frame case (143).
Mutation check: '254 -' for '255 -' failed 6 differential tests, rounding so failed 5, an exclusive upper key bound failed 3.
The default Node in the sandbox was v22; bootstrap requires Node 24, so /opt/node24 was used.
Full npm test / npm run check not run, per the wave rules (they need edge-flac.wasm).
